KeyPassages: Numbers 1:52; Numbers 2:17; Numbers 10:14; Song of Solomon 2:4
BiblicalUsage: The flag is the standard of the tribe, raised over the camp in the wilderness and carried before the host. Each tribe pitches by its own standard, and the armies march in order under their banners. The Song pictures the beloved's banner over her as love itself, the standard under which she stands.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the standard is the sign of belonging: every tribe knew its banner, and every believer knows whose flag flies over them. The banner is the sign of whose we are, and the standard we march under is the name of the Lord.
